$schema_note: A NeuralBridge-authored machine-readable descriptor for agents and tool-calling frameworks. Not a claim of conformance to any particular external agent-manifest standard — those are still unsettled as of writing. Treat this as a structured, always-current sibling of /llms.txt.
name: Industrial Autonomous Assurance
description: Evidence infrastructure for CRA Article 14 (Reg. (EU) 2024/2847) and Machinery Regulation Annex III 1.1.9 (Reg. (EU) 2023/1230): a hash-chained record of what is on each machine, what was verified, and when.

auth.name: X-API-Key
auth.note: A missing key is 401. A valid key on a plan that doesn't include the route is 402 (never 403), with a structured JSON body naming the required plan and the exact remedy — safe to parse and act on automatically.

tiers.name: Supplier
tiers.note: Sales-assigned pricing, no self-serve price yet.

honesty_note: Checkout and the live plans API are real code paths, but they only activate once the operator finishes deploying the hosted API and setting NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSURANCE_API_URL. Do not report purchase as available unless you have independently confirmed the live API responds.
